'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Justin Desai DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
